newVocabulary.note: Go or return home. 回 means return; 家 means home.
Oily or greasy when describing food here; as a noun, 油 also means oil.
Icy or ice-cold when describing food or drinks here; as a noun, 冰 means ice.
Care about or be concerned about someone. 謝謝你關心 means “Thank you for caring.”
Introduce advice: “It would be best to…” or “You should…” This is stronger than merely listing a preference.
A measure word for bags or packets, such as a packet of medicine. 三包 means “three packets.”
The verb “sleep,” also found in 睡覺. Use 睡 when comparing how long people sleep.
An hour as a duration: 三個小時 means “three hours.” It does not state a clock time.

冰.note: 冰 means “ice,” and describes something icy or ice-cold here. 冰的東西 refers to cold or icy things to eat or drink.
冰.memory: Two ice strokes 冫 beside 水: picture water turning icy. The left has two strokes, not the three of 氵.

u48-a-little-degree.title: 一點 — quantity and degree
u48-a-little-degree.pattern: 一點 + NP / Vs + 一點 / 有（一）點 + Vs / 一點點
u48-a-little-degree.explanation: 一點 + NP gives a small quantity; Vs + 一點 gives a slightly different degree, often comparative; 有（一）點 + Vs gives a slight state rather than a comparison; 一點點 emphasizes a tiny amount or degree.
u48-a-little-degree.remember: Post-state 一點 can express comparative improvement; pre-state 有（一）點 expresses a slight state.

u48-action-comparison-de.title: Comparing actions with 得
u48-action-comparison-de.pattern: Comparative + Action + 得 + State / Action + 得 + Comparative + State
u48-action-comparison-de.explanation: Compare how an action is performed using 得 de with 比. Pattern 2 often repeats the verb where an object/action noun requires it. 不 precedes 比; questions use 嗎 or 是不是. This 得 is complement de, not modal děi.
